description: Building Footprints (West Vancouver) is a data set deposited in psf.sgdc by its authors District Of West Vancouver. The building layer was compiled by McElhanney Ltd in 2016 using ortho imagery and LiDAR data. District of West Vancouver maintains this data. Major developments have been added to the inventory but not all newer residential construction has been captured since 2016. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: Shapefile. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Contains information licensed under the Open Government license - West Vancouver. https://mapping.westvancouver.ca/OD/Open_Government_License_West_Vancouver.pdf. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
